issues.t: Takata front airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing you can notice. The danger only shows up in a crash, when the airbag deploys.
issues.why: Many 2006-2012 IS 250 and 2006-2013 IS 350 sedans, some IS F models and 2010-2015 IS 250C/IS 350C convertibles have Takata airbag inflators. As they age in heat and humidity, they can burst when the airbag fires and throw metal pieces into the cabin.
issues.next: Look up your VIN on the NHTSA recall site or call a Lexus dealer today. The inflator replacement is free, and you should not put it off.

issues.t: Engine stalls from failing fuel pump (recall)
issues.sym: The engine runs rough, hesitates, the check engine light comes on, or the car stalls while driving and may not restart.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank has an impeller that can swell and rub, so the pump stops sending enough fuel. The recall covers the 2014 IS F, 2014-2015 IS 350, 2017 IS 200t and 2018-2019 IS 300 and IS 350.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the open recall and have a Lexus dealer replace the fuel pump for free. If the engine starts running rough at speed, pull over somewhere safe.

issues.t: Variable valve timing gear bolts can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: A rattle or grinding noise right after a cold start, a check engine light, or in the worst case the engine shuts off while driving.
issues.why: Bolts that hold the variable valve timing gear housing to its sprocket can work loose from hard knocks inside the gear right after cold starts. If the parts separate, the engine can stall. The recall covers 2006-2011 IS 350 and 2010-2011 IS 350C.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. A Lexus dealer replaces the valve timing gear unit for free. Don't ignore a new cold-start rattle.

issues.t: Fuel pulsation damper can leak fuel (recall)
issues.sym: A raw gasoline smell from the engine bay, or wet spots of fuel on top of the engine.
issues.why: The rubber diaphragm in the fuel pulsation damper on the high-pressure fuel rail can harden and crack with age, letting fuel seep out near hot engine parts. The recall covers 2006-2013 IS 350 and 2010-2014 IS 350C.
issues.next: Don't drive it if you smell fuel strongly. Check your VIN for the recall; the dealer replaces the damper for free.

issues.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
issues.sym: One or both wipers stop moving or only move part way, often under a heavy load such as wet snow on the glass.
issues.why: The nuts that hold the wiper arms on were not tightened enough at the factory, so the arm can slip on its shaft when it is under load.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. The dealer installs new wiper arm nuts for free. Until then, clear heavy snow off the windshield before using the wipers.

issues.t: Fuel leak at the fuel pressure sensor (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell around the car or from the engine bay, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: On 2006-2011 IS 350s, fuel can seep where the fuel pressure sensor mounts to the high-pressure fuel rail, which is a fire risk.
issues.next: Don't keep driving if you smell fuel. Check your VIN for recall 14V647 and have the dealer do the free repair.

issues.t: Valve springs can break (recall)
issues.sym: A tapping or clattering noise from the engine, rough running, a check engine light, or the engine stopping while driving.
issues.why: Some valve springs in 2006-2008 IS 350 engines could crack because of a manufacturing flaw. A broken spring lets a valve misbehave and can stop the engine.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 10V309. A Lexus dealer replaces the valve springs for free.

issues.t: Carbon buildup causing rough idle and misfires
issues.sym: A shaky or rough idle, a flashing or steady check engine light with misfire codes, hesitation, or a knocking sound, usually after 50,000 miles or more.
issues.why: The IS 250's 2.5L V6 sprays fuel straight into the cylinders, so fuel no longer washes the intake valves. Oil vapor bakes onto the valves and combustion chambers over time and disrupts airflow and burning.
issues.next: Have the misfire diagnosed so coils and plugs are ruled out. If carbon is the cause, a shop can do a walnut-blast or chemical cleaning of the intake valves. Quality fuel and regular oil changes help slow it down.

issues.t: Water pump leaking coolant
issues.sym: Pink coolant drips or dried pink crust under the front of the engine, a sweet smell, a coolant level that keeps dropping, or a whining or grinding noise from the front of the engine.
issues.why: The water pump's internal seal wears out and lets coolant seep through the weep hole. On these V6 and V8 engines it is a common wear item between roughly 60,000 and 120,000 miles.
issues.next: Keep the coolant topped up with Toyota/Lexus pink coolant and watch the temperature gauge. Have the pump replaced before it fails completely, since overheating can damage the engine.

issues.t: Dashboard or door panels crack, turn sticky or melt
issues.sym: The top of the dashboard becomes shiny, sticky or gummy, cracks, or gives off glare on the windshield. Door panels can get sticky too.
issues.why: The dashboard and door panel material breaks down with heat and humidity over the years.
issues.next: Ask a Lexus dealer with your VIN whether Lexus's warranty enhancement still applies. If not, a dash cover or replacement panel is the fix.

issues.t: Convertible hardtop won't open or close
issues.sym: On the IS 250C and IS 350C, the retractable hardtop stops part way, won't close, shows a warning, or water ends up in the trunk.
issues.why: The folding roof relies on many switches, sensors, a hydraulic pump and a control unit. A failing sensor, low hydraulic fluid, a weak battery or worn seals can stop it or let water in.
issues.next: Don't force the top. Check the battery first, then have a dealer or convertible specialist scan the roof control unit. Have the seals and drains checked if water gets in.

issues.t: Harsh 2-3 shift and misfire codes on the IS 300 automatic
issues.sym: The transmission bangs from second into third gear when you accelerate gently, and the check engine light may come on with misfire codes P0300-P0306.
issues.why: Lexus traced both conditions to the engine computer's programming on early IS 300 automatics and released updated software.
issues.next: Ask a Lexus dealer or a shop with Toyota software to check for and install the engine computer update. Rule out worn coils or plugs if misfire codes return.

issues.t: Misfires from oil in spark plug wells or failing coils
issues.sym: A rough idle, stumbling under load, and a check engine light with misfire codes. You may find oil on the spark plugs when they are pulled.
issues.why: The valve cover gasket and spark plug tube seals harden with age and let oil into the spark plug wells, which shorts the coil boots. Ignition coils on the inline-6 also wear out.
issues.next: Have the misfiring cylinder found by swapping coils. Replace the valve cover gasket and tube seals if there is oil in the wells, and replace any bad coil.

issues.t: Check engine light from failed oxygen sensors
issues.sym: Check engine light on, sometimes with worse fuel economy. Owners report replacing oxygen sensors more than once.
issues.why: The heated oxygen sensors in the exhaust wear out or their heaters fail with age and mileage.
issues.next: Have the codes read. If an oxygen sensor or its heater circuit is flagged, replace that sensor with a quality part.

issues.t: Sticky or melting dashboard on the IS 300
issues.sym: The dashboard surface turns soft, sticky, shiny or deteriorates, especially in cars that sit in the sun.
issues.why: The dash's soft coating breaks down with heat and UV exposure over time.
issues.next: A dash cover protects it and cuts glare. A replacement dash pad is the permanent fix.

issues.t: Front-end clunk from worn control arm bushings or ball joints
issues.sym: Clunking or knocking from the front over bumps, loose or wandering steering, or a pull to one side.
issues.why: The front suspension has several control arms with rubber bushings and ball joints that wear out with age and miles. Lexus issued a bulletin on how to inspect the ball joints on these cars.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected. Worn arms or bushings should be replaced, followed by a wheel alignment.

issues.t: Front tires wearing on the inside edge
issues.sym: The inner edges of the front tires wear much faster than the rest of the tread.
issues.why: The IS 300's front alignment settings and aging suspension bushings put more load on the inner edge of the tire.
issues.next: Rotate tires regularly and get an alignment check. If the bushings are worn, replace them before buying new tires.

issues.t: Worn engine and transmission mounts
issues.sym: More vibration at idle, a clunk when shifting into drive or reverse, or a thump when you get on and off the gas.
issues.why: The rubber in the engine and transmission mounts cracks and sags with age, so the drivetrain moves more than it should.
issues.next: Have the mounts inspected while someone shifts between drive and reverse. Replace any that are cracked or collapsed.

issues.t: CD changer or radio knob stops working
issues.sym: The CD changer sticks, won't eject, or stops playing, or the radio tuning knob stops responding.
issues.why: The original CD changer mechanism wears out, and Lexus released changer improvements in a bulletin. The tuning knob's encoder also fails with use.
issues.next: A car audio shop or Lexus dealer can repair or replace the changer or head unit. Many owners swap in an aftermarket unit.

issues.t: Cruise control won't engage
issues.sym: The cruise control won't turn on, won't set a speed, or cuts out.
issues.why: Lexus ran a limited service campaign to replace the cruise control switch on 2002 IS 300s, and speed control was a top complaint area for 2001-2002 cars.
issues.next: Have a Lexus dealer check whether the campaign was done on your car. If not, the cruise control switch is the first part to check.

issues.t: Climate control panel finish peeling
issues.sym: The coating on the heater and A/C control panel peels or flakes off.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for the finish on the climate control panel housing breaking down.
issues.next: Purely cosmetic. A Lexus dealer can replace the panel housing if it bothers you.

issues.t: Clutch chirp with the pedal released
issues.sym: On manual transmission cars, a chirping or squeaking noise in neutral with your foot off the clutch.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for a chirp coming from the clutch release parts on manual IS 300s.
issues.next: Have a shop confirm the noise source. It is usually not urgent, but the fix is often done when the clutch is replaced.

issues.t: A/C blows the wrong temperature or from the wrong vents
issues.sym: Air comes out warmer or colder than you set, one side differs from the other, or air comes from the wrong vents.
issues.why: The small electric servo motors that move the blend and mode doors inside the dash can fail electrically. Lexus extended coverage on these motors for many models and issued airflow bulletins.
issues.next: Ask a Lexus dealer with your VIN whether the A/C servo motor customer support program (20LE01) covers your car before paying for repairs.

issues.t: Front brakes squeal or squeak
issues.sym: High-pitched squealing from the front brakes, often at low speed or light braking, even with plenty of pad left.
issues.why: Vibration between the pads and rotors causes the noise. Lexus released bulletins with revised front pads for several IS versions.
issues.next: Have the dealer check whether the brake squeal bulletin applies. New pads, shims and anti-squeal grease usually fix it.

issues.t: Navigation screen flashes pink or goes black
issues.sym: The center screen flashes pink or purple, goes blank, or the system reboots on its own.
issues.why: Older navigation software on these Lexus head units causes the fault. Lexus released a software update.
issues.next: Have a Lexus dealer update the navigation software. If the screen stays black after the update, the display or head unit may need replacing.

issues.t: Knocking noise from the vacuum pump at idle
issues.sym: A knocking or tapping noise from the engine at idle.
issues.why: On the 3.5L V6, the engine-driven vacuum pump for the brake booster can make a knock. Lexus issued a bulletin with a repair procedure.
issues.next: Have a Lexus dealer confirm the noise comes from the vacuum pump and apply bulletin LSB0060-23.

issues.t: Rattle at idle from a fuel line touching the body
issues.sym: A light rattle or buzz at idle that you can hear or feel in the cabin.
issues.why: A fuel line on the 3.5L V6 can touch the body and pass vibration into the car. Lexus issued a bulletin for it.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check bulletin L-SB-0040-19. Repositioning or adding a clamp to the line usually ends it.

issues.t: Hard starting with lean check engine codes
issues.sym: The engine cranks longer than normal before it starts, and the check engine light may come on with lean codes such as P0171 or P0174.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for hard starts and lean-running codes across many 2013-2020 models.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer about bulletin LSB0005-23 before replacing parts.

issues.t: Bluetooth phone won't pair or keeps dropping
issues.sym: Your phone won't pair, disconnects during calls, or streaming audio cuts out or switches modes.
issues.why: Phone software updates and the head unit's software don't always work well together. Lexus released several bulletins on Bluetooth connection problems.
issues.next: Delete the phone from the car and the car from the phone, then pair again. If it keeps happening, ask the dealer about a head unit software update.

issues.t: Front bumper pops out near the headlight
issues.sym: The front bumper cover sticks out or leaves a gap next to the fender and headlight, usually on the driver's side.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for the left front bumper on IS 500 models coming loose from its mounts near the fender.
issues.next: Have a Lexus dealer inspect it under bulletin L-SB-0010-24, ideally while the car is under warranty.

issues.t: Check engine light with oxygen sensor code P013A
issues.sym: Check engine light on with code P013A (slow response from the rear oxygen sensor).
issues.why: Lexus issued a technical tip for this code on some 2022 models.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the code against bulletin L-TT-0311-22 before replacing the sensor.

issues.t: Remote app and connected services stop working
issues.sym: The Lexus app can't lock, unlock or start the car remotely, or connected services won't activate.
issues.why: Lexus released several bulletins for telematics features that fail to activate or respond.
issues.next: Check your subscription first. If it is active and still fails, ask a dealer to check the telematics module under the bulletins.

issues.t: Check engine light with idle or throttle codes on the V8
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P0505 (idle control) or P2111 (throttle stuck open). The idle may be unsteady.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for the 5.0L V8 used in the IS F and IS 500, and changed the design of the throttle body and two engine ventilation hoses to fix it.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask a Lexus dealer about bulletin L-SB-0032-25. The fix is the updated throttle body and hoses.

issues.t: 12-volt battery runs down when the car sits
issues.sym: Slow cranking, a no-start, or warning messages after the car has been parked for a week or more.
issues.why: Modern Lexus electronics draw a small current even when the car is off. Lexus bulletins (including L-SB-0019-25 for the 2026 IS) warn that storage time, heat or cold and this standby drain weaken the 12-volt battery on cars that sit.
issues.next: Drive the car regularly or use a battery maintainer if it sits. Have the battery tested; a weak one should be replaced.

issues.t: Clunk on downshifts when slowing down
issues.sym: A noticeable clunk or bump from the drivetrain as the car coasts or brakes toward a stop, usually as the transmission drops from 5th to 4th or 3rd gear. It tends to be worse before the engine is fully warm.
issues.why: Lexus released bulletin L-SB-0048-25 for this. Owners who read it say it updates the engine and transmission control software, changing how fuel is cut and how the downshift is timed.
issues.next: Ask a Lexus dealer whether bulletin L-SB-0048-25 applies to your VIN. If the clunk started suddenly or comes with a warning light or slipping, have the transmission checked rather than assuming it is the same issue.
